nuggets.text: Cutter Boley threw for 387 yards and six touchdowns in his debut, the most passing yards ever by a Sun Devils QB in a debut.
Reed Harris, Grayson Rigdon and Omarion Miller each topped 100 receiving yards vs. Morgan State, an ASU first since at least 1996.
The Sun Devils led Morgan State 70-7 after three quarters, so the coaches agreed to shorten the fourth quarter to 10 minutes.
Kenny Dillingham on the shortened quarter: 'I didn't even know that was legal, but I learned something today.'
The Sun Devils have scored on their first drive of the season for 11 straight years, the longest such streak in the country.
The Sun Devils have won six straight regular-season games against ranked teams, the longest active streak in the nation.
Kenny Dillingham began coaching at 17 as a high school JV assistant and was an offensive coordinator by 21.
The Sun Devils won the 2024 Big 12 title after being picked to finish last in the conference.
Linebacker Owen Long led the entire FBS with 151 tackles at Colorado State in 2025 before joining the Sun Devils.
Sparky the Sun Devil was drawn by Disney illustrator Berk Anthony, rumored to have based the face on Walt Disney.
